CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

MAYOR OF BANDAR LAMPUNG

LAMPUNG PROVINCE

REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANDAR LAMPUNG CITY

NUMBER: 03 OF 2019

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

MAYOR OF BANDAR LAMPUNG,

Considering:
a. that in order to fulfill the constitutional rights of women, every citizen has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity, has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence and to improve the quality of life of women which is one of the responsibilities of the Regional Government; b. that in the effort to fulfill women's rights, efforts need to be made by families, communities, and the Regional Government, as referred to in letter a, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation on the Protection of Women; In View of:
1. Article 18 paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia; 2. Law Number 28 of 1959 concerning the Stipulation of Emergency Law Number 4 of 1956 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1956 Number 55, Emergency Law Number 5 of 1956 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 1956 Number 57) concerning the Establishment of Level II Regions Including Municipalities Within the Level I Region of South Sumatra as Law (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1959 Number 73, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 1821); 3. Law Number 7 of 1984 concerning Ratification of the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women (Convention on the Elimination of all forms of Discrimination Against Women) (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1984 Number 29, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3277); 4. Law Number 19 of 1999 concerning Ratification of ILO Convention Number 105 Concerning The Abolition Of Forced Labour [ILO Convention on the Abolition of Forced Labour] (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1999 Number 55, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3834); 5. Law Number 39 of 1999 concerning Human Rights (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1999 Number 165, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3886); 6. Law Number 13 of 2003 concerning Manpower (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2003 Number 39, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia 4279); 7. Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2004 Number 95, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4419); 8. Law Number 13 of 2006 concerning Protection of Witnesses and Victims (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2006 Number 64, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4635); 9. Law Number 21 of 2007 concerning the Eradication of the Criminal Act of Trafficking in Persons (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2009 Number 58, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4720); 10. Law Number 11 of 2008 concerning Information and Electronic Transactions (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2008 Number 58, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4843); 11. Law Number 11 of 2009 concerning Social Welfare (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2009 Number 12, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4967); 12. Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2014 Number 244, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5587) as amended several times most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015 concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2015 Number 58, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5679); 13. Government Regulation Number 3 of 1982 concerning Amendment to the Territorial Boundaries of the Level II Municipality of Tanjungkarang-Telukbetung (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1982 Number 6, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3213); 14. Government Regulation Number 24 of 1983 concerning the Change of Name of the Level II Municipality of Tanjungkarang-Telukbetung to the Level II Municipality of Bandar Lampung (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1983 Number 30, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3254); 15. Government Regulation Number 4 of 2006 concerning the Implementation and Cooperation for the Recovery of Victims of Domestic Violence, (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2006 Number 15, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4604); 16. Government Regulation Number 09 of 2008 Concerning Procedures and Mechanisms for Integrated Services for Witnesses/Victims of the Criminal Act of Trafficking in Persons (TPPO) (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2008 Number 22, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4818); 17. Government Regulation Number 39 of 2012 concerning the Implementation of Social Welfare (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2012 Number 68, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5294); 18. Regulation of the Minister of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Number 2 of 2008 concerning Guidelines for the Implementation of Women's Protection (State News of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2008 Number 2 of 2008; 19. Regulation of the Minister of Home Affairs Number 15 of 2008 concerning General Guidelines for the Implementation of Gender Mainstreaming in the Regions, as amended by Regulation of the Minister of Home Affairs Number 67 of 2011 (State News of the Republic of Indonesia Number 67 of 2011); 20.

Article 24

The Business Sector has the obligation and responsibility:
a. provide contributions and guarantees in the implementation of protection of women;
b. provide facilities and infrastructure to improve efforts to fulfill rights and protection of women; danc. be responsible for carrying out prevention, risk reduction and handling of cases of women victims of violence, exploitation, and trafficking in persons.

Article 14

1. Legal aid is legal services provided by legal assistants and advocates to provide assistance to witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
2. Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Accompanying and/or defending in every legal handling process;
b. preparing reports on legal handling progress.

CHAPTER III

SCOPE

Article 3

The Scope of Protection of Women includes:

a. Prevention;
b. Service; and
c. Empowerment.

Paragraph One

Forms of Violence

Article 17

1. In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family, community, national, and state life, women must be empowered.
2. Women's empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed to obtain their opportunities and rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in economic, socio-cultural, political, and legal activities.

Article 25

1. The Mayor conducts guidance, coordination of implementation and supervision of protection of women.
2. The Mayor may delegate guidance, coordination of implementation and supervision, as referred to in paragraph (1), to the Regional Apparatus Organization that carries out the main duties and functions in the field of protection of women.
3. The procedures and mechanisms for guidance, coordination, implementation and supervision shall be further regulated by Mayor Regulation.

Article 15

1. Repatriation is an effort to return female victims of violence from the city area to their area of origin.
2. Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. coordinating with relevant agencies for victim repatriation.
b. preparing progress reports on the victim repatriation assistance process;
c. conducting monitoring for at least three months after the victim is returned to their family.

CHAPTER VIII

CRIMINAL PROVISIONS

Article 28

Any person or body/institution/organization that deliberately fails to fulfill the rights and protection of women may be subject to criminal sanctions in accordance with applicable regulations and laws.

CHAPTER V

INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK FOR PROTECTION OF WOMEN

Part One

Guidance, Coordination, Implementation and Supervision of Protection of Women

Second Paragraph

Rights of Victims

Article 16

1. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
2. Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Economic and social empowerment;
b. Education; and
c. Monitoring and/or follow-up guidance.

Article 26

1. The delivery of protection services for women is carried out in an integrated manner by the UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
2. The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by Mayor Regulation.

CHAPTER V

INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK FOR PROTECTION OF WOMEN

Part One

Guidance, Coordination, Implementation and Supervision of Protection of Women

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 26

1. The delivery of protection services for women is carried out in an integrated manner by the UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
2. The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by Mayor Regulation.

Article 25

1. The Mayor conducts guidance, coordination of implementation and supervision of protection of women.
2. The Mayor may delegate guidance, coordination of implementation and supervision, as referred to in paragraph (1), to the Regional Apparatus Organization that carries out the main duties and functions in the field of protection of women.
3. The procedures and mechanisms for guidance, coordination, implementation and supervision shall be further regulated by Mayor Regulation.

Article 24

The Business Sector has the obligation and responsibility:
a. provide contributions and guarantees in the implementation of protection of women;
b. provide facilities and infrastructure to improve efforts to fulfill rights and protection of women; danc. be responsible for carrying out prevention, risk reduction and handling of cases of women victims of violence, exploitation, and trafficking in persons.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 17

1. In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family, community, national, and state life, women must be empowered.
2. Women's empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed to obtain their opportunities and rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in economic, socio-cultural, political, and legal activities.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.

Article 14

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.

Article 13

1. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can perform their social functions properly.
2. Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. providing assistance during the case handling process;
b. conducting counseling.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 16

2. Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.

13. Article 21

The implementation of women's empowerment in the legal field as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (2) includes:
a. increasing awareness and knowledge in the legal field through communication, information and education services; and

Article 19

a. increasing knowledge, attitudes and skills to encourage the fulfillment of tiered education in accordance with potential to improve social status;
b. increasing awareness, willingness and ability to overcome health problems through quality promotive, preventive, curative, and rehabilitative efforts, especially in the field of reproductive health.
c. increasing awareness and knowledge about independent, healthy and prosperous family planning including access to consultation services and marriage registration; and
d. facilitation and efforts to preserve customs and develop science, technology, arts and culture for the advancement of women.

MAYOR OF BANDAR LAMPUNG,

Considering:
a. that in order to fulfill the constitutional rights of women, every citizen has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity, has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence and to improve the quality of life of women which is one of the responsibilities of the Regional Government; b. that in the effort to fulfill women's rights, efforts need to be made by families, communities, and the Regional Government, as referred to in letter a, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation on the Protection of Women; In View of:
1. Article 18 paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia; 2. Law Number 28 of 1959 concerning the Stipulation of Emergency Law Number 4 of 1956 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1956 Number 55, Emergency Law Number 5 of 1956 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 1956 Number 57) concerning the Establishment of Level II Regions Including Municipalities Within the Level I Region of South Sumatra as Law (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1959 Number 73, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 1821); 3. Law Number 19 of 1999 concerning Ratification of ILO Convention Number 105 Concerning The Abolition Of Forced Labour [ILO Convention on the Abolition of Forced Labour] (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1999 Number 55, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3834); 5. Law Number 13 of 2003 concerning Manpower (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2003 Number 39, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia 4279); 7. CHAPTER III

SCOPE

Article 3

The Scope of Protection of Women includes:

a. Prevention;
b. Service; and
c. Empowerment.

Article 25

1. The Mayor conducts guidance, coordination of implementation and supervision of protection of women.
2. The Mayor may delegate guidance, coordination of implementation and supervision, as referred to in paragraph (1), to the Regional Apparatus Organization that carries out the main duties and functions in the field of protection of women.
3. The procedures and mechanisms for guidance, coordination, implementation and supervision shall be further regulated by Mayor Regulation.

CHAPTER V

INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK FOR PROTECTION OF WOMEN

Part One

Guidance, Coordination, Implementation and Supervision of Protection of Women

Article 26

1. The delivery of protection services for women is carried out in an integrated manner by the UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
2. The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by Mayor Regulation.

CHAPTER VI

EVALUATION, REPORTING

AND ACCOUNTABILITY

Article 27

1. OPD provides prevention services, risk reduction services and case handling services for women who are victims.
2. OPD that implements the provision of protection of women is obliged to carry out evaluation and make accountability reports to the Mayor.

CHAPTER VIII

CRIMINAL PROVISIONS

Article 28

Any person or body/institution/organization that deliberately fails to fulfill the rights and protection of women may be subject to criminal sanctions in accordance with applicable regulations and laws.

Article 17

1. In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family, community, national, and state life, women must be empowered.
2. Women's empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed to obtain their opportunities and rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in economic, socio-cultural, political, and legal activities.

CHAPTER VII

FINANCING

Funding for the protection of women may be sourced from the State Revenue and Expenditure Budget, the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget of both the Province and the City and/or other lawful sources that are non-binding in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 14

1. Legal aid is legal services provided by legal assistants and advocates to provide assistance to witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
2. Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Accompanying and/or defending in every legal handling process;
b. preparing reports on legal handling progress.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 17

1. In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family, community, national, and state life, women must be empowered.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to work and do business independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.
